514498484,513889352,513275495,500701636,201321569,25183716,510830789,

begin
  insert into process_for_file (file_type, file_no, treatment_type, process_co, process_ser, last_update_time)
  select 100, f.file_no, 0, 1808,
         (select nvl(max(p2.process_ser), 0) + 1
          from process_for_file p2
          where p2.file_type = 100
          and p2.treatment_type = 0
          and p2.file_no = f.file_no),
         to_char(sysdate, 'yyyymmddhh24miss')
  from (select to_number(regexp_substr(l_list, '\d+', 1, level)) file_no
        from dual
        connect by level <= regexp_count(l_list, '\d+')) f
  where not exists (select 1
                    from process_for_file p
                    where p.file_type = 100
                    and p.treatment_type = 0
                    and p.file_no = f.file_no
                    and p.process_co = 1808);
  dbms_output.put_line('group 1: ' || sql%rowcount || ' rows inserted');
end;

begin
  insert into process_for_file (file_type, file_no, treatment_type, process_co, process_ser, last_update_time)
  select 100, f.file_no, 0, 1808,
         (select nvl(max(p2.process_ser), 0) + 1
          from process_for_file p2
          where p2.file_type = 100
          and p2.treatment_type = 0
          and p2.file_no = f.file_no),
         to_char(sysdate, 'yyyymmddhh24miss')
  from (select to_number(regexp_substr(l_list, '\d+', 1, level)) file_no
        from dual
        connect by level <= regexp_count(l_list, '\d+')) f
  where not exists (select 1
                    from process_for_file p
                    where p.file_type = 100
                    and p.treatment_type = 0
                    and p.file_no = f.file_no
                    and p.process_co = 1808);
  dbms_output.put_line('group 2: ' || sql%rowcount || ' rows inserted');
end;
